title: Per-algorithm smoke tests (1.14) and end-to-end validation with multi-seed experiment (Faz 3)
purpose: Guard every algorithm and comparison policy against NaN/Inf, empty offers and boundary prices in short scenarios, then validate the full user journey and run the multi-seed comparison that PLAN Faz 3 requires before any learning claim.

scenarios: For each AlgorithmType: 2 agents (one with 1 plant, one with 3 plants), PAYASPTF and PAYASBID, 60 periods, default lags [1, 24] (OQ-7): checks acting, offers, logging (T - 1 AgentStepLog rows per agent) and the pre-learning random phase for t <= 24.

For each learning AlgorithmType: the same 60-period scenario with the TEST-ONLY override batch_size = 8, learning_starts = 8 (OQ-7) so that gradient updates happen: checks the learning path. Production defaults stay at OQ-3.
checks: Exactly one Offer per plant per period, offerPrice within [lowerBidBound, upperBidBound].
No NaN/Inf in offers, budgets, PTF and AgentStepLog float fields (extra['non_finite'] never present).
Learning runs: AgentStepLog.learning_active True from the expected period, critic_loss not None after it.
Fail-stack enabled run (DDPG, L = 2): interventions logged only after 2 consecutive failures.
Fail-stack disabled runs: no interventions, share of integer-valued prices close to the share expected from the price quantum (PLAN 1.5 check).
work_packages.marker: pytest.mark.smoke, runtime target under 10 minutes on CPU for the full matrix

modify: analiz.md (closing status of each finding, user approval required for wording)

work_packages.journey: Create a scenario from library agents -> run -> watch status -> start an HPO study -> watch -> apply best parameters (if OQ-9 resolved), all through the Django test client with synchronous process patches.
work_packages.experiment: Each learning algorithm against RANDOM, MARGINAL_COST and FIXED_MARKUP under identical scenarios, fail-stack disabled, N seeds (N set by the user under the statistical-validity and fair-comparison skills). Report mean and confidence intervals of the evaluation metrics. A learning claim is made only if the trained agent separates from the comparison conditions. The experiment design itself is planned with @experiment-runner and the empirical-rigor skill before execution.

public_interfaces.description: Clones the configured proxy scenario once per (algorithm, seed), runs serially or with a process pool, writes a CSV of evaluation metrics per run. No result interpretation in code.

invariants: Smoke tests do not depend on network or GPU
Experiment runs never reuse HPO search seeds
edge_cases: Agent whose variable cost exceeds upperBidBound (MARGINAL_COST clipped to the bound)
Scenario with total capacity below demand (supply shortfall every period)
acceptance_criteria: Experiment report produced and reviewed by the user
approval_note: Approved by the user on 2026-10-06. Open questions OQ-1..OQ-19 are resolved in ARCHITECTURE.md section 11. The entries in resolved_open_questions are binding and override any wording below that says "proposal", "per OQ-x" or "if approved".

resolved_open_questions.OQ-7: Smoke tests use 60 periods with default lags [1, 24]. Expected AgentStepLog rows per agent = T - 1. Learning-path smoke runs use a TEST-ONLY config override batch_size = 8, learning_starts = 8 so that updates happen within 60 periods. Production defaults (OQ-3) are unchanged.
resolved_open_questions.OQ-9: Agent.algorithm_params (JSON) plus AlgorithmDefault model, both added by data_model (migration 0012). Effective params = AlgorithmDefault for the type, overridden by Agent.algorithm_params, overridden by HPO overrides.
